tasks.short: Prepare graphical/tabular field productivity or profitability reports.

steps.what: Verify actual field boundaries, yield records, costs and productivity/profitability definitions
inputs: actual field/season identifiers
actual measured yield, area and recorded cost/revenue sources
outputs: checked actual field-report inputs and chosen definitions

steps.what: Transfer existing field yield, area and financial records into report drafts
inputs: checked actual field-report inputs and chosen definitions
actual source fields: field/season ID, quantity, unit, date, cost/revenue amount and currency

steps.what: Assemble graphical and tabular summaries using native chosen metric and chart definitions
inputs: source-linked field-report draft tables
checked actual field-report inputs and chosen definitions

steps.what: Check complete final report, source totals, cost allocations, uncertainty and exact recipient
inputs: draft graphical/tabular field report
actual source records and permitted reporting scope
outputs: checked final field report and authorised recipient

steps.what: Save final graphical/tabular field report
inputs: checked final field report and authorised recipient

inputs: checked final field report and authorised recipient

tasks.design: Use native farm-management {OPS_SYSTEM}, financial {ERP} and agricultural GIS {OTHER} exports first, then link actual remaining duplicate entry into {BI} report drafts. Retain definitions, cost allocation and complete report checking before separate save and delivery.
tasks.previous_blocker: Field reports can re-key recorded yield/cost data and repeat chart assembly.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing identified records and native chart definitions support deterministic preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Productivity and profitability depend on actual area, season and allocation choices.
tasks.human_edge: The technician spots a profitable-looking field created by omitted actual costs.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: existing farm/financial records and native charts can support field reports; valid metric and cost interpretation remain human.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Actual harvest/field and finance owners produce yield, area, dates, quantities/units, amounts/currencies and field/season IDs; technician verifies source quality and allocation in s1. Missing IDs/costs return to manual reconciliation, never invented figures.

Productivity/profitability alternatives reweight actual report scope. Existing native integrations/charts earn zero new saving. Savings only duplicate transfer and repeated assembly, not native runtime.
Delivery only if owned; actual internal recipient uses internal authority with same final-version gate. No spending or field action inferred. Shared source preparation counted once.
unknowns: Which field/financial data are actually re-keyed?
research_questions: Does source-linked report assembly save effort after full allocation and total checks?

Actual imagery provider produces corrected bands, time, CRS, processing version and cloud/quality mask; actual soil/weather owners produce dated/geolocated measured records. No new raw-image calibration assumed. Savings only actual repeated load/setup, not existing native computation runtime. Existing loading/saved procedures earn zero saving. Technician chooses methods and fully checks spatial/temporal comparability.
No treatment prescription or machine activation inferred. Any actual analysis delivery or field action is a separately final-version/state gated step with no saving claimed.
